name: Projects Closed This Month
query:
SELECT
    ps.work_team AS "Work Team:Link/Work Team:200",
    wt.team_name AS "Team Name::200",
    COUNT(ps.name) AS "Projects Closed This Month:Int:150"
FROM
    `tabProject Setup` ps
LEFT JOIN
    `tabWork Team` wt ON wt.name = ps.work_team
WHERE
    ps.status = 'Completed'
    AND MONTH(ps.completion_date) = MONTH(CURDATE())
    AND YEAR(ps.completion_date) = YEAR(CURDATE())
GROUP BY
    ps.work_team, wt.team_name
ORDER BY
    COUNT(ps.name) DESC;
